elev.source: MOLA MEGDR via NASA Mars Trek (Mars_MGS_MOLA_DEM_mosaic_global_463m_8), 8-bit linear stretch -8200..21230 m, ~115 m/level

slope.source: derived: 90th percentile of slope computed on 8192x4096 MOLA grid (~2.6 km/px) inside each 4x4 block

rough.source: derived: std-dev of MOLA elevation inside each output cell (terrain roughness proxy)

ice.source: SWIM 2.0 global composite ice consistency (Planetary Science Institute / NASA), 3 km/px, swim.psi.edu

ti.source: MGS TES thermal inertia (Christensen et al.; Mellon/Putzig binned maps) via ASU JMARS WMS layer TES_Thermal_Inertia_numeric, 2048x1024

dust.source: TES surface dust abundance (Bandfield 2002) via ASU JMARS WMS layer TES_Dust_numeric, 8 ppd
